title: Apply for a liquor licence exemption for a non-profit organisation
summary: Non-profit organisations can apply for a liquor licence exemption to sell alcohol at up to six fundraising functions in a year.
intro:
If you’re a non-profit organisation and you want to sell alcohol at an event, you may be eligible to have up to 6 fundraising functions a year without the need to get a liquor licence.

Examples of functions include dinners, balls, conventions, sporting events, performances, exhibitions, seminars, carnivals and fetes.

A non-profit organisation (also known as a non-proprietary association) includes amateur sports clubs, community groups, parents and citizens’ associations, and charities.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Must be a non-profit organisation (non-proprietary association) as defined under liquor laws and described by Liquor & Gaming.
Must currently hold a limited liquor licence on behalf of an organisation.
Must not have been prevented from holding a liquor licence by an order.
Must not be an organisation that has been declared ineligible for exemption.
Must not be an organisation, secretary, or office holder who has committed a serious offence under the liquor laws during the last 6 months.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Liquor licence exemption for fundraising function'.

how_to_steps.text: Print, complete and sign the form.
Submit your completed form at least 14 days before the start of the function, by mail or email, to the details on the form.
Forward a copy of the form to the local police and local council where the function is being held.

faqs.q: What types of events qualify for the exemption?
faqs.a: Examples of qualifying functions include dinners, balls, conventions, sporting events, performances, exhibitions, seminars, carnivals, and fetes.

faqs.q: Who is considered a non-profit organisation for this exemption?
faqs.a: A non-profit organisation includes amateur sports clubs, community groups, parents and citizens’ associations, and charities.

faqs.q: How many functions can I hold under this exemption?
faqs.a: You may be eligible to have up to 6 fundraising functions a year without needing a liquor licence.
